00046 void UnaryNegUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw() 
00047 { 
00048   const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize(); 
00049   float* const outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData(); 
00050   float* const inputSamples = inputs[Operand].processBlock(shouldDelete, blockID, channel);
00051   vDSP_vneg(inputSamples, 1, outputSamples, 1, numSamplesToProcess);
00052 }
